messages:
maya: heads-up — nightly eval flagged a sharp spike in failures for the long-context QA suite on the new int3 candidate. eval-bot posted summary below.
eval-bot: nightly-eval report: model=redwood-int3 v0.3.1, suite=long-context-qa, failures=18/200 (baseline 2/200), avg_coherence_drop=0.27, severity=high 
liam: ack, I saw the alert. quick guess: non-deterministic quantization rounding + RNG seed interplay. int3 kernels are still experimental.
olivia: can we reproduce locally? need exact command and env. also assign owner so we don't lose this. @liam want to own initial triage?
liam: I can take it. first steps: re-run eval with fixed seeds and deterministic kernel flags. if failure persists with same seed -> model dist change; if it flips across seeds -> RNG/quant interaction.
maya: thanks. putting a quick checklist: 1) reproduce with fixed seed 2) run float32 baseline on same commit 3) run int4/quant4 variant for comparison 4) capture full generations and diffs -> attach to ticket.
liam: repro command I'm running now: 
```
python eval/run.py --model redwood-int3:v0.3.1 --suite long-context-qa --batch 8 --seed 42 --deterministic-kernel true --output /tmp/int3-run.json
```
liam: also toggling `--seed` across [0,1,42,999] to see flip rate.
olivia: good. please add logs to a ticket and drop link here. set initial severity P2 (customer-impacting in nightly but not yet in prod).
maya: P2 sounds right. Also note: we saw a cluster of failures concentrated on prompts >8k tokens. could be KV cache rounding.
liam: noted. early look: many failures are short hallucinations on numeric reasoning prompts. attaching a sample diff (brief): expected mentions of transaction dates, model returns shifted months.
sam (oncall-bot): re-run of nightly eval triggered by @liam requested; build #12234 queued. ETA ~12m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
liam: quick root-cause plan: (A) reproduce deterministic runs -> if stable regression, bisect model commit that introduced change (B) if non-deterministic, instrument quant kernel RNG and compare int3 vs int4 traces (C) if KV cache implicated, add extra precision path for >8k contexts and re-run.
maya: assign ticket INF-4123 to @liam, add label `nightly-alert`, `int3-onboard`. @olivia can you own communications if we need to notify PMs/SEs?
olivia: yep, I'll handle comms. Also please add a short eval snippet for SRE to check GPU kernel versions, sometimes driver updates change fp rounding.
liam: putting steps and initial findings into INF-4123 now, will update with the first deterministic run in ~20m.
maya: thanks — let's reconvene in this thread after the deterministic runs. :thumbsup:
